messages.text: waking up. coffee #1. trying to get the nginx cert sorted
certbot is failing. venue network isn't forwarding 80/443 to my machine. i can see the port scan requests but they never arrive
ugh. yeah, hackathon wifi is a nightmare for inbound traffic usually
do you want me to just skip https for now? or should i generate a self-signed cert?
self-signed is fine as a stopgap. we don't have real traffic yet so the warning won't matter until later
ok. generating it now. also added restart: unless-stopped to all services in compose.yaml just in case the venue resets routers or whatever
good call on the restart policy. i hate when containers die after a reboot and i have to manually start them again
linkmit.duckdns.org is resolving now, cert is loaded. browser says insecure but it's working
that's fine for tonight. we can revisit proper certs if the network opens up tomorrow
yeah. i'll leave a note in the deploy doc so we don't forget to swap it out later
thanks. also, did you get that index on auth_attempts added?
yep, pushed it last night before i went to sleep. `CREATE INDEX idx_auth_ip_time ON auth_attempts (ip, created_at);`
perfect. i'm about to test the trigram matching stage, hoping it catches more than i think it will
good luck. if you need me to add a debug endpoint for the pipeline stages, let me know
